newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron up 4.65 pct on OPSF fund news.
newsitem.headline: Petron up 4.65 pct on OPSF fund news.

text.p: Oil refiner Petron Corp rose by 40 centavos, or 4.65 percent, to nine pesos at mid-session on news the government had committed to pay in full some 2.4 billion pesos in claims of oil refiners from the Oil Price Stabilisation Fund (OPSF), traders said.

"Petron is up because of news that the oil companies will be fully reimbursed their OPSF claims. The non-settlement of these dues has been dampening the price of the stock," said Fitz Aclan, research head at Dharmala Securities (Phils) Inc.
Petron Corp has the biggest claims amounting to 1.085 billion pesos from the OPSF, a buffer fund that cushions domestic oil prices from fluctuations in international crude prices.
The fund which allows the oil companies to withdraw money when crude prices are high and when the peso weakens against the dollar, has been running a deficit since early this year.
A total of 6.012 million Petron shares were traded by mid-session.
